description: Had a great time at Clinton Community Day yesterday. The Hudson Valley is worth fighting for and days like these remind us why! I love getting out into our communities, meeting neighbors, listening to what's on people's minds, and celebrating the places that make our district so special. It was great spending the day with Gregory Campus, candidate for NYS Assembly in the 106th District. Thank you to the Town of Clinton Republican Committee for having us and to everyone who stopped by to say hello!!
